name: Georgia DECA
what_you_do: Join a school DECA chapter to prepare for college and careers. Members go to conferences, compete in DECA's competitive events and can earn a share of scholarships. The state hosts events like a Fall Rally.
who_can_apply: Students at a Georgia school with a DECA chapter. The state page does not list grade or age rules.
pay_detail: Not a job. Student dues are $16 ($8 national and $8 state), per the state page.
duration: Membership is for one school year
deadline_text: No join deadline listed. The state calendar lists a Fall Rally on October 21, 2026 at Six Flags Over Georgia.
how_to_apply: The state page is written for school advisors. Chapters sign up and renew members online at deca.org. Ask a business or marketing teacher if your school has a chapter. A school can start one using the Start a Chapter page. The page says the Georgia DECA minimum is 15 members.
notes: Contact the state staff through the Contact Us page at gadeca.org.
